First, note the date format: 03-12-1023 is likely DD-MM-YYYY, so 3rd December 1023.  

40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Add 1 more day → 281 days total.  

In the Gregorian calendar (proleptic), 1023 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1023 not divisible by 4).  

Start: 1023-12-03  
Add 281 days:  

December 1023 has 31 days → from Dec 3: 31 - 3 = 28 days used in Dec, remaining 281 - 28 = 253 days left.  

1024 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  

January 1024: 31 days → 253 - 31 = 222 left  
February 1024: 29 days → 222 - 29 = 193 left  
March 1024: 31 days → 193 - 31 = 162 left  
April 1024: 30 days → 162 - 30 = 132 left  
May 1024: 31 days → 132 - 31 = 101 left  
June 1024: 30 days → 101 - 30 = 71 left  
July 1024: 31 days → 71 - 31 = 40 left  
August 1024: 31 days → 40 - 31 = 9 left  
September 1024: 30 days → 9 days into September → September 9, 1024.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1024-09-09
